## Adjudications

**`cor-planar-simple-graph-edge-bound`**
- **Terra — `confirmed_fatal` (`logic`).** Step 1.2 applied double counting to a face-indexed relation with no finiteness. Not a 30-second gap: face-finiteness is its own inductive lemma resting on polygonal Jordan.
- **DeepSeek — `false_positive`, no mutation.** The construction it calls false is true. Separate the components into disjoint discs and the complement of their union is connected and unbounded, hence inside the unbounded face; each component's rightmost drawing point has a clear ray east, so it sits on that face's frontier. DeepSeek passed this same step two rounds ago, and its earlier nested-component objection is what the redrawing answers. There is a residual gap it didn't name — the joining arcs need a *vertex*, which follows from edge-face incidence at the extreme point — comfortably nonfatal.

I repaired at the root rather than the symptom. `lem-plane-face-handshake-by-girth` **states the equality** ∑ℓ(f)=2|E|; this item's `[L2]` reported only the derived inequality. That under-citation is what caused all four prior rejections on this item: three said "[L2] is only an inequality", and the previous repair answered them by re-deriving the equality by hand — importing the hypothesis Terra just caught. So `[L2]` now quotes the lemma faithfully and step 1.2 just cites it. Finiteness lives where it's proved. `thm-double-counting` and `lem-plane-edge-face-incidence` left `deps` with their last uses, and the batch-6 proof contract was rewritten and re-merged.

**`rem-riemann-stieltjes-conventions-and-scope`** — both `confirmed_fatal`.
- DeepSeek is right, a name collision: `thm-holder-finite-real-exponents` is Hölder's *inequality for sums*, unrelated to a Hölder-continuity exponent. The remark's *reason* checks out against `plan-spec.json` — this page is order 163, real powers arrive at 177 — so only the pointer was wrong. Repointed to `def-real-power`, `forward_refs` updated to match.
- Terra is right on `a<b`: on `[a,a]` the integral is 0 by convention so every bounded integrand is integrable, while no partition exists, so the equivalence genuinely fails. Stated the hypothesis plus one sentence on why it isn't cosmetic. I did **not** add the "bounded integrand" clause Terra raised in an earlier round — that row is closed `confirmed_nonfatal` and R1 gives no licence to reopen it.

## Three things you need before publishing

1. **`pre-step8d` was unusable as a baseline.** It was taken at `06:27:40Z`; commit `044c15b4` (owner item 3) landed at `06:29:11Z`, inside the window, so the guard reports `nonfatal-edit` on `rem-real-exponents-deferred` — an owner-approved scope-denial edit. I took **`pre-step8e`** immediately before adjudicating; against it the guard reads `2/2 licensed by a confirmed_fatal`.
2. **`lem-plane-triangulation-is-connected` has no `risk_review`** and is CRITICAL 8 — `risk-report --require-reviewed` fails. It was built today for owner item 4 and missed the step-6 refuter wave. I read its proof closely (step 3.1 now rests on it) and found nothing false, but that's my reading, not a refuter's, so I did not write a record claiming evidence I don't have. Dispatch a refuter and it can be written at once.
3. **`fwdcheck` now exits 1 at HEAD** with 16 `forward-undeclared` errors — none on my items, all committed in `044c15b4`. The scope-denial edits added wikilinks pointing forward without declaring them, so the sky/↗ marking isn't being applied. Frontmatter-only fix, but it touches published items. Affected: `ex-square-root-is-half-holder`, `ex-x-to-the-beta-separates-the-holder-classes`, `thm-holder-exponent-above-one-forces-constancy`, `lem-power-over-geometric-null`, `rem-absolutely-continuous-function`, `rem-monotone-convergence-theorem`, `fs-continuous-bijection-is-a-homeomorphism`, `thm-countable-subsets-of-omega-one-are-bounded`.

`precheck`, `proof-contract --strict` (0/476), `finite-smoke`, `depcheck`, `extcheck`, `rendercheck`, `content-policy` and `step8-guard` all pass. Full write-up in `research/frontier-10-alpha-report.md` §"Stage 3, round 4". No published file was mutated; no permission prompt raised.
